text: k W, and k W h.
They look almost the same. But they mean very different things.
It tells you how fast energy is being used.
Think of it as the speed.
It is the total amount used, over time.
Think of it as the energy in the battery.
They are linked: energy equals power, times time.
A charger gives eight kilowatts, for five hours.
Eight times five: forty kilowatt hours goes into the battery.
k W is a rate. k W h is an amount.
Never mix them up in one formula.
Your turn. A motor uses two kilowatts for three hours.
Two times three: six kilowatt hours.
